objective: Establish the analytic and deterministic feasibility of the SPS-C04 correlation-scale communication crossover without executing any scientific seed experiment.

inputs.predecessor_status: SPS-C03 dropped; WO-07 seeds 4001-4008 motivation-only and permanently barred from SPS-C04 inference
inputs.field_requirement: episode-frozen stationary vector field with an explicit ensemble covariance and declared ell_c; vortex_scale is ineligible
inputs.message_contract: exactly three bounded scalars per sender per control step

verification_command: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m unittest tests.test_fields tests.test_communication tests.test_policies tests.test_coordination -v

required_gates.literature_veto: no primary source already establishes the same unique-capture sign crossover and estimation-diversity decomposition
required_gates.theory: derive a plausible single estimator-side crossover in eta under explicit assumptions
required_gates.field: recover declared covariance and constant marginal velocity variance across ell_c within prospectively frozen tolerances
required_gates.communication: independent and all-to-all arms differ only in aggregation; exactly three scalars per sender; permutation equivariant
required_gates.mechanism_microcases: constant, opposing-region, and homogeneous-noise cases have their predicted ordering
required_gates.provenance: future arms can share exact initial state, Brownian tensor, field realization, and tie stream

stop_conditions: any attempt to use vortex_scale as ell_c
any scientific seed or performance sweep is requested
any WO-07 outcome is used to select a grid or numerical threshold
analytic crossover is absent in defensible parameter regimes
field covariance or deterministic mechanism tests fail
the communication intervention changes observation access, capacity, or stochastic streams
fallback_task: Record the failed theory or feasibility gate, keep SPS-C04 unsupported, and advance literature or alternative-question analysis without running seeds.
positive_interpretation: Authorize a separate preregistration work order to freeze eta grid, practical threshold, simultaneous inference, fresh seeds, and a bounded CPU diagnostic. This work order itself cannot support SPS-C04.
null_interpretation: Kill or redesign the phase-boundary question before scientific compute.
reversed_interpretation: Reject the one-boundary theory; do not fit a post-hoc non-monotone story.

gate_outcome.theory: conditional pass: general covariance derivation and a defensible point-sensor crossover exist, but eta is not geometry invariant
gate_outcome.field: pass: immutable periodic Gaussian field has exact finite-basis covariance, declared ell_c, invariant marginal variance, and canonical fingerprint
gate_outcome.communication: pass: self-only and all-to-all arms share one three-scalar encoder/decoder and differ only in aggregation
gate_outcome.mechanism_microcases: pass: constant, opposing-region, homogeneous-noise, correlated-error, sensing-overlap, and permutation tests
gate_outcome.runtime_integration: blocked by original allowlist: config, environment reset, matched runner, and runtime diagnostic logging require a successor work order

scientific_status: completed conditional theory and deterministic engineering gate; no scientific seeds; standard runner integration remains blocked
